## About Tent Now
Tent Now is a UAE-based tent rental and supply company with 30 years of experience (founded 1994).
Headquartered in SAIF Zone, Sharjah. Serves all 7 UAE Emirates.
Primary services: Ramadan tent rental, Majlis setups, Iftar event tents, industrial storage tents, tarpaulins.

- All structures are Civil Defence approved
- Municipality permits handled for all Emirates
- 30+ years in operation since 1994

## Pricing Guidance (2026)
- Home Majlis: from AED 3,000
- Corporate/Hotel Iftar Tent: AED 15,000–80,000+
- Industrial Storage Tent: AED 15–40/sqm/month
- Tarpaulins (PE200): available in bulk
